courthouses.name: Placerville Main Street Branch
courthouses.note: West Slope criminal courthouse. Departments 1, 2, 6 & 7; Depts. 1, 2 and 7 are Criminal Pre-Trial and Criminal Trials (Dept. 6 vacant). Criminal filings and payments accepted here. Assignments rotate.

courthouses.name: Placerville Building C Branch
courthouses.note: Departments 5 & 8. Dept. 8 hears Behavioral Health Court, Mental Health Diversion Court and Veterans Treatment Court (plus restraining orders, CARE Court, dependency); Dept. 5 family law. Family Law Facilitator/Self-Help (530) 621-5098 and Court Administration are here. No regular criminal arraignment calendar listed.

departments.label: Department 8
departments.type: Behavioral Health Court, Mental Health Diversion Court, Veterans Treatment Court, restraining orders, CARE Court

courthouses.name: Cameron Park Branch
courthouses.note: Departments 9 & 10. Dept. 10 hears Traffic and juvenile infractions (also small claims, unlawful detainers, child support); Dept. 9 civil/probate/Family Wellness Court. Traffic only — no misdemeanor/felony calendar listed. Traffic email infractionservices@eldorado.courts.ca.gov.

departments.label: Department 10
departments.type: Traffic, juvenile infractions, small claims, unlawful detainers, DCSS

courthouses.name: South Lake Tahoe Branch
courthouses.note: Departments 3, 4, 11 & 12. Dept. 3: Criminal Pre-Trial, Criminal Trials, Domestic Violence Compliance Court. Dept. 4: juvenile justice, family, civil, probate. Dept. 12: traffic, family law, restraining orders. Criminal/Traffic clerk (530) 573-3044; Family Law Facilitator (530) 573-3066.

departments.label: Department 3
departments.type: Criminal Pre-Trial, Criminal Trials, DV Compliance Court

departments.type: Juvenile Justice / Dependency, Family, Civil, Probate

departments.type: Traffic, family law, restraining orders, juvenile infractions

public_defenders.name: El Dorado County Public Defender — Shingle Springs Office
public_defenders.note: From El Dorado Hills: (916) 358-3555 ext. 6440; from South Lake Tahoe: (530) 573-7955 ext. 6440.

public_defenders.name: El Dorado County Public Defender — South Lake Tahoe Office
El Dorado County Alternate Public Defender (conflict office)
public_defenders.note: Represents clients when the Public Defender can't (conflict/unavailability). Mailing: PO Box 1738, Placerville 95667.

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Auburn office
legal_aid.serves: Low-income residents of Amador, Calaveras, El Dorado, Nevada, Placer and Sierra counties
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing and public benefits (CalWORKs, CalFresh, Medi-Cal, GA, Social Security/SSI, unemployment, SDI). Does not list criminal defense. Office 190 Reamer Street, Auburn 95603; evening intake message line (866) 815-5990.

legal_aid.name: El Dorado Superior Court — Family Law Facilitator/Self-Help Center
legal_aid.serves: Self-represented people with El Dorado cases
legal_aid.what: Free procedural information (not legal advice, not confidential). Topics listed include family law, restraining orders, small claims, unlawful detainer, civil harassment, CARE Act and Expungement. Placerville (Building C) (530) 621-5098; South Lake Tahoe (530) 573-3066.

programs.name: El Dorado County Pretrial Services (Probation)
programs.summary: Probation scores pretrial defendants with the VPRAI-R risk tool; risk level, most serious charge and failure-to-appear history set the level of pretrial supervision. The page publishes the scoring (SB 36 disclosure).

programs.name: Behavioral Health Court
programs.summary: Intensive court program for adults and transitional-age youth with mental illness in the justice system: evaluation, treatment and monitoring by a team of court, law enforcement, probation and mental health, with a clinical manager per participant. Dept. 8, Building C.

programs.name: Veterans Treatment Court
programs.summary: Court-supervised community treatment for veterans and active-duty members; typically 12–24 months. Apply through your attorney using local form CR-183. Dept. 8, Building C.

programs.name: Mental Health Diversion Court
programs.summary: Listed on the Judicial Assignments page as a Dept. 8 (Building C) calendar. No separate program description found on the court site.
programs.todo: eligibility/process not published on court site

programs.name: Family Wellness Court (with Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians)
programs.summary: Joint state–tribal collaborative court for system-involved youth and families; hears juvenile, dependency, DV and criminal matters together with culturally based restorative services. Dept. 9, Cameron Park.

programs.name: Domestic Violence Compliance Court
programs.summary: Listed on the Judicial Assignments page as a Dept. 3 (South Lake Tahoe) calendar.

jails.name: Placerville Jail
jails.phone_note: In-person visits daily 8–11 a.m. and 1–4 p.m., Mon–Thu evenings 7–10 p.m.; first come, first served; call ahead for evening visits. Video visits and messaging via NCIC ((800) 943-2189). Cash or cashier's check can be brought to the facility (or mailed) for an inmate's account.
jails.court_ids_note: nearest, not confirmed — West Slope criminal departments 1, 2, 7 sit at the Main Street Branch.
jails.todo: Sheriff pages don't state men/women housing; no dedicated commissary/deposit page found (money rule is on the visiting page).

jails.name: South Lake Tahoe Jail
jails.address: 1051 Al Tahoe Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150
jails.phone_note: In-person visits Mon–Sat 8–11 a.m. and 1–4 p.m., Tue–Thu evenings 7–10 p.m.; call ahead for evening visits. Video visits/messaging via NCIC.
jails.court_ids_note: nearest, not confirmed — Dept. 3 (criminal) is at the South Lake Tahoe Branch.

jails.name: Juvenile Treatment Center — South Lake Tahoe (Probation)
jails.address: 1041 Al Tahoe Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150
jails.phone_note: Secure juvenile detention for up to 40 youth; call to schedule a visit.
jails.court_ids_note: nearest, not confirmed — juvenile justice is heard in Dept. 4, South Lake Tahoe Branch (per assignments page).
